tagline: A leading provider of uniform rentals and workplace supplies across the United States and Canada
hero_kpi_rationale: Recurring revenue represents 95% of total revenue, making it the structural pillar of the business model and a key indicator of cash flow stability and predictability.

kpis.name: Recurring Rental Revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue derived from weekly and long-term rental contracts.
kpis.description: Recurring revenue includes uniforms, mats, towels, linens, and restroom supplies delivered on a regular basis.
kpis.signal: 95% of revenue comes from recurring contracts: very high visibility.

kpis.name: Direct Sales Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from one-time sales, including custom apparel for large enterprises.
kpis.description: Direct sales primarily targeted at national or regional large enterprises.
kpis.signal: Only 5% of revenue, but potential for targeted growth.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from rental services and direct sales.
kpis.description: Total revenue for fiscal year 2025, driven primarily by recurring services.
kpis.signal: $2.7B in revenue for 2025, consolidated following Aramark spin-off.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin of $64.4M on $2.7B in revenue in 2025.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Loss after taxes for the full fiscal year.
kpis.description: Net loss of 1.5% of revenue in 2025, likely due to interest expenses and exceptional charges post-spin-off.
kpis.signal: Net loss of $40.2M, despite a positive operating income of $64.4M.

kpis.name: Cash from Operations
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from core business activities.
kpis.description: Cash from operations in line with operating income of $64.4M.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Employees distributed across more than 325 locations in the United States and Canada.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Unfavorable Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is listed first in the 10-K, with strong language (materially adversely affect) and multiple references to past and present impacts. The intensity of the language and recurrence of macroeconomic factors (inflation, wars, pandemics) reinforce its importance. The Macro category is highly weighted in the current context.

risks.title: Increased Competition in the Industry
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described as affecting pricing, margins, and market share, with mention of powerful national competitors. The language is repeated and emphasizes pricing pressure and the need to invest. Presented consistently compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned multiple times with alarming language (disruptions, delivery delays, lower fill rates). It is linked to geopolitical factors (Ukraine, Middle East) and climate events. Its intensity is reinforced by direct and recurring operational impacts since COVID-19.

risks.title: Rising Energy Costs
risks.score_rationale: The risk is specifically tied to conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East, with a direct impact on operating margins. The language is precise and current, indicating a real concern. The Macro category is critical, but the impact is partially manageable through pricing adjustments.

risks.title: Dependence on International Suppliers
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights reliance on single and foreign suppliers, with risks of supply disruption. The language emphasizes lack of control and reputational risks. This risk is amplified by current trade and geopolitical tensions.

risks.title: Ineffectiveness of Restructuring Plan
risks.score_rationale: The restructuring plan is recent (Q1 2026) and presented as critical to future performance. The language indicates risk of disruption, cost overruns, or inefficiency. Its new and strategic nature justifies high severity.

risks.title: Trade and Tariff Policy
risks.score_rationale: The risk relates to recent customs tariff measures and international retaliation. The language is concerned, with mention of direct impacts on costs and competitiveness. The Regulation category is moderately weighted, but the current geopolitical context elevates it.

ai_positioning.summary: VSTS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
